About me

I'm a senior Mechanical Production Engineering student at Alexandria University (GPA 3.3/4.0), based in Alexandria, Egypt. I'm looking for an internship where I can apply engineering fundamentals and gain hands-on experience in manufacturing and industrial operations. My graduation projects at Groupe SEB and Titan Cement, and summer trainings at Titan Cement, Alexandria Shipyard and Lamar, introduced me to lean tools in real plants — and I back them up with data skills in Power BI, SQL and Excel.
